title: Canonical Knowledge Graph
subtitle: Posters as projections of a higher-dimensional structure

blocks.text: The canonical artifact is the evolving knowledge graph rather than any individual poster.

blocks.caption: Canonical Knowledge Graph — Posters as projections of a higher-dimensional structure
blocks.explanation: Posters provide different projections of the same underlying typed structure, allowing discovery, navigation, synthesis and future expansion without forcing a single visual representation.
